title: Window Cleaning in Sierra Vista, Steiner Ranch | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for Sierra Vista acreage homes in Steiner Ranch. Pure water, poles to three stories, about $450 for a 4,500 sq ft home. Text for a quote.
intro: Sierra Vista is a small acreage section of Steiner Ranch where homesites run an acre or more. CleanzATX cleans windows here, on homes that have a lot of glass and a lot of yard around it.

sections.h2: What Sierra Vista homes are like
paragraphs: Space is the difference here. Most of Steiner Ranch is built close together, but Sierra Vista has homesites of an acre or more, so houses sit back from the street with real distance to the next neighbor. Prices run from about $1.2M to $2.5M. The section is small, not gated, and covered by the Steiner Ranch Master Association. On bigger lots, builders usually go bigger on the house too, with long rear elevations, large patio doors and a lot of picture glass facing the yard and the hills.
Longer driveways and more landscaping also mean more ground around each home to keep in mind when we plan the work.

sections.h2: What Sierra Vista windows deal with
paragraphs: An acre means more trees, and more trees means more of everything that falls from them. Live oak and cedar pollen settle on the glass every spring and winter, and leaf litter packs into screens and tracks. Spiders move in near mature plantings, so webs turn up around frames and eaves. Irrigation systems on larger lots often cover a lot of ground, and the spray that reaches the house leaves white hard water spots on the lower windows. Those can etch if ignored, so we treat them at $10 per pane when ordinary cleaning will not lift them.
Open yards also mean wind and dust, so glass facing the lot gets dusty between visits.

Without a gate, access is simple. We park near the house, and we ask you to unlock side and rear gates and keep dogs inside. Our dual RO, four stage pure water system dries without spots, and the water fed poles reach up to three stories so we never lean a ladder on your stone or stucco. Interior windows are cleaned by hand with squeegees. On a lot this size we can add driveway and patio cleaning, since the surface cleaner makes quick work of flatwork at $0.18 per sq ft for concrete. We try to pair Sierra Vista with other Steiner Ranch homes, usually within two weeks.
For a 4,500 sq ft home, exterior windows are about $450 at $0.10 per sq ft. Plan on about three and a half to four and a half hours outside, and around two hours for the inside.

why: Acre lots mean more trees, so we clean screens and tracks along with the glass.
Pure water dries clear on picture windows that face a big open yard.
Poles reach upper glass without ladders on your landscaping.
Driveway and patio cleaning can ride along on the same visit.

faq.q: Will you need to walk the whole yard?
faq.a: Only as far as the windows go. We work from the ground with poles, and we ask that gates are unlocked and pets are inside. We avoid stepping on planting beds and rinse any splash off the patio.

faq.q: How do you handle sprinkler spots on lower windows?
faq.a: Light spots often come off with a regular pure water clean. Stubborn ones get hard water spot removal at $10 per pane. We will point out any pane that looks etched before we start.

faq.q: Can you clean upper windows that face the yard?
faq.a: Yes. The poles reach up to three stories from the ground. That covers second story bedrooms and tall rear windows without a ladder against the house.

faq.q: What does a typical Sierra Vista home cost?
faq.a: Exterior windows are $10 per window or about $0.10 per sq ft. A 4,500 sq ft home comes to about $450, and inside and out is $15 per window. The minimum job is $200.

faq.q: Do you offer a recurring plan?
faq.a: Yes, the Clean Windows Club. Twice a Year is 10% off, Triannual and Quarterly are 15% off, and Every 2 Months is 20% off. The upper tiers add free yearly screen cleaning and a 7 day rain guarantee.
